summary: Iteration 12 verified the TRANSFORM CHOREOGRAPHY + CONVERGENCE LINE + AWS BADGE RELOCATION pass. Badges stay static after entrance (transform none/no animation). Convergence line does not overflow on mobile. action_items: MINOR NAMING MISMATCH: review request lists velocity testids as milestone-partnership / milestone-select-tier / milestone-advanced-tier / milestone-genai-competency, but the actual code (content.js ACCELERATION_STORY.steps) uses ids partnership/select/advanced/genai — so real testids are milestone-partnership, milestone-select, milestone-advanced, milestone-genai. All 4 render fine; only the spec-vs-code testid naming differs. Consider aligning (either rename step ids to select-tier/advanced-tier/genai-competency in content.js, or update the spec).
critical_code_review_comments: Velocity milestone step ids in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js (line 162-167) don't match the ids called out in the review spec (short vs -tier/-competency). No functional impact but external test scripts that hardcode the spec ids will fail.
TransformChapter.jsx handles all P0 spec beats correctly (convergence line origin-right scaleX collapse, staggered badge entrance, gates at 0.79 / 0.84 / 0.94). Clean and readable — no issues.
